Nadia CSM: Quick heads-up
Pre-proc call 11am PT tomorrow with Chris' procurement team. They want a clear monthly SLA + deterministic credit calc for uptime and p95 latency (embeddings). Renewal flagged if unclear.

Tom (SRE): Baseline hosted SLA = 99.9% monthly. We calculate uptime credits monthly: 1% invoice credit per 0.5% below SLA, rounded down. Latency credits are separate and prorated by days p95 exceeded target.

Chris (Buyer): We need an Excel-friendly formula and one worked example. Also want to see Dedicated option with tighter guarantees.

Ivy - Solutions: Proposed formulas (plain text):
UptimeCreditPercent = max(0, floor((SLA - ObservedUptime) / 0.5%) * 1%)
LatencyDailyPercent = ceil(max(0, ObservedP95 - TargetP95) / 50ms) * 0.5%
LatencyCreditPercent = min(10%, sum(LatencyDailyPercent * (DaysExceeded / 30)))
CombinedPercent = min(12%, UptimeCreditPercent + LatencyCreditPercent)
FinalCredit = InvoiceAmount * CombinedPercent

SLAWatchBot: account snapshot for chris_inc: ObservedUptime=99.82%, ObservedP95=260ms, TargetP95=150ms, DaysExceeded=2

Ivy - Solutions: Worked example (single-line for Excel):
Invoice=50000, UptimeCredit=0% (floor((99.9-99.82)/0.5)=0), Over_ms=110, LatencyBuckets=3, LatencyDaily=1.5%, LatencyCredit=1.5%*2/30=0.1% -> Combined=0.1% -> FinalCredit=$50

Tom (SRE): Ops note: we prorate latency by fractional days from monitoring. For Hosted we can enable automatic 30m burst and escalation to reduce long windows; that reduces observed DaysExceeded in practice.

Ivy - Solutions: Dedicated offer: SLA 99.95%, uptime credit = 1% per 0.25% below SLA, latency guaranteed p95 <=160ms for model family; latency credits only trigger for extreme events (>200ms for >3h) with fixed 2% per event up to 6% monthly. Includes optional paid warmstart SLA.

Chris (Buyer): Perfect. Can you put this in a one-page comparison + copy-paste Excel lines? Procurement needs by Thursday COB.

Nadia CSM: Action items: Ivy drafts one-pager + Excel lines, Tom confirms monitoring proration details, I'll send to Chris by EOD tomorrow. Tagging as renewal-risk. :thumbsup:
